What is ReplyInPublic?

ReplyInPublic is a web inbox for comments customers have already posted in public. It collects those comments, groups the ones that describe the same issue, and leaves the reply with a person. The product does not post a reply by itself. Opening the inbox requires a sign in.

By Pranav Kaja. Last updated 16 November 2026.

Who it is for

ReplyInPublic is for brand teams that want to answer feedback customers already posted in public. The point is to move attention from satisfaction and feedback surveys toward those public comments. Surveys measure satisfaction. Replies earn it.

What the live inbox shows

The live workspace shows real public comments for five kitchen brands: KitchenAid, Nespresso, Breville, Instant Pot, and Ninja. Comments are read from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X (formerly Twitter), and Reddit.

A comment may sit on the brand's own post, or on a creator or community post. The inbox can filter those two apart. Comments that describe the same issue are shown together, so one comment can be read next to the others like it. Each comment can be parked for a reply, followed up later, or kept as feedback for the brand.

What ReplyInPublic does not do

  • It does not post a reply. A person reviews the comment, can keep a draft, and opens the original conversation to answer.
  • It does not run a satisfaction survey.
  • It does not publish a price on this site.
  • The live inbox is those five brands. It is not a feed of every brand.
